cost_scope: Job costs exclude separately reported immutable dataset preparation. Standalone method cost adds common preparation; improved imitation additionally adds shared expert-label cost.

shared_dataset_costs.accounting: wall_time_s includes oracle_wall_time_s; each scalar objective query counts one requested full rollout, including failed queries. This is not a count of backend-internal replay solves.
